title: Structure-aware Reinforcement Learning for Protein Directed Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.39048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein optimization remains a longstanding goal in life sciences. Existing machine learning-assisted directed evolution (MLDE) methods primarily rely on sequence-only features, overlooking the critical spatial constraints and co-evolutionary interactions encoded in protein structures. However, directly integrating structural information remains challenging due to the scarcity of reliable mutant structures. To address these issues, we propose StructEvo, a novel structure-aware reinforcement learning framework for protein directed evolution. StructEvo employs a delta-structure fusion encoder to approximate mutant structure features via feature differences, enabling dynamic incorporation of spatial knowledge. The vast mutation space is then decomposed into manageable subspaces through a structure-aligned hierarchical action network, while a geometric constraint further stabilizes delta feature learning. translated_title: 面向蛋白质定向进化的结构感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 蛋白质优化仍然是生命科学领域一个长期追求的目标。现有的机器学习辅助定向进化（MLDE）方法主要依赖仅序列特征，忽视了蛋白质结构中编码的关键空间约束和共进化相互作用。然而，由于可靠的突变体结构十分稀缺，直接整合结构信息仍然充满挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了StructEvo，一种新颖的面向蛋白质定向进化的结构感知强化学习框架。StructEvo采用增量结构融合编码器，通过特征差异来近似突变体的结构特征，从而实现空间知识的动态整合。随后，通过结构对齐的分层动作网络将庞大的突变空间分解为可管理的子空间，同时几何约束进一步稳定了增量特征的学习。我们的方法优于先前的最先进方法。
tldr: StructEvo提出了一种结构感知的强化学习框架，通过增量结构融合编码器动态整合空间知识，并利用结构对齐的分层动作网络分解突变空间，在克服突变体结构稀缺难题的同时超越了现有的蛋白质定向进化方法。
